items.prompt:
Edit input 1 into a simple instantly readable martial game-card painting: ONE SILVER SPEAR PIERCING ONE DARK ARMOR PLATE. This is a structural correction, not a detail embellishment.
Input 1 locks the quiet solid muted gray-blue BACKGROUND, square format, restrained palette and sparse layout. Its current giant triangular combined object is an error: DO NOT preserve that merged silhouette. Input 2 (blood-arrow card) is a reference only for a clean isolated weapon silhouette and economical broad paint. Do not copy its red arrow or background.

Show just two distinct objects crossing at center. A single moderately sized flat dark charcoal armor plate, approximately a tilted quadrilateral, occupies the middle third of the square, across the bottom-left to top-right diagonal. Its outline must be simple and fully distinguishable. One straight spear runs upper-left to lower-right along the opposite diagonal. A short narrow black shaft enters from the upper-left frame edge, goes BEHIND the plate, and ONE pointed SILVER LEAF-SHAPED SPEARHEAD emerges THROUGH a small hole at the center of the plate toward the lower-right. The spearhead is long and slender, with two large blade planes and one central ridge, and its sharp point ends before the lower-right edge. The visible blade must be much narrower than the plate. The plate cannot become a giant spear blade. Make the depth and occlusion explicit: shaft behind plate, small torn hole surrounding socket, pointed silver blade in front of plate. A thin ivory exposed-metal rim around the hole and a tiny dark crimson mark are the only damage details. The plate remains one connected quiet dark shape. Generous gray-blue negative space surrounds both objects. The read must be: spear passes through armor. No red tassel, ribbon, flying chips, fragments, extra plates, explosion, flare, complicated jagged rim, crack network, human, hand or scenery.

Rough hand-painted anime concept illustration: large connected opaque color masses, a few broad directional brush swipes and blunt dabs, coherent quiet dark plate, two broad silver/blue-gray blade planes, decisive handmade edges. Selective clarity at the tiny contact and sharp tip, secondary shaft and background simple. Matte muted colors and a small crimson focal accent. No fine engravings, dense scratches, triangular facet mosaics, glossy 3D, photoreal chrome, smooth airbrush, all-over grain/canvas filters, text, watermark, frame or UI. Keep exactly one spear and one armor plate; simplicity and recognizable penetration come before material detail.
